Commentary.Commentary: The visitors will be disappointed with the proceedings. They were on top for a long time but the last few wickets have put the game back in balance. Yes, they are chasing 191 in around 74 odd overs but things won't be that easy against a bowling line-up with three quality spinners. It promises to be a thrilling chase. Join us in a while for it.

The last three wickets added 102 runs and when you read that Bangladesh have to chase 191, it tells you how vital these runs will be for the hosts. Dimuth Karunaratne scored a brilliant ton but he kept losing out on partners and the hosts will wonder what would have happened had he got little support.

What a comeback by the home side! When they were reeling at 7 for 217, it looked like Bangladesh might wrap things up as early as possible and level the series in time but the tail has wagged for the hosts and boy, how well has it wagged!

OUT! Shakib takes the final one! Floats it on the stumps, Lakmal comes down and has a slog at it. The ball goes off the outer half and skies towards wide long off. Mosaddek gets across to his left and pouches the catch. That ends the innings for Sri Lanka. Bangladesh need 191 runs to win!
Lands it outside off, Lakmal looks to chop it down to third man but the ball bounces off the wicket and the first slip fielder does well to take it.
Sandakan gets in line and defends it watchfully.
Fuller on the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Lakshan Sandakan is the last man in.

OUT! Oh no Dilruwan, what have you done! How many times have we heard that one should never run on a misfield but cricketers sometimes don't pay heed to cliches. Bowls it on middle, Dilruwan looks to clip it towards mid-wicket. There was a fumble by the fielder and that made Lakmal push for the single. Subashis, who was stationed there recovers in time and fires a throw at the non-striker's end. Mehedi does the rest and appeals. It is referred upstairs. Replays show Dilruwan's dive does not save him and what a way to lose your wicket after such a grind! Sri Lanka lead by 189!

DP comes forward and keeps it out towards the on side.
Floats it on off, Dilruwan comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge towards the vacant short leg region.
Lands it on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, chopped towards short third man by Dilruwan.
Too full outside off, kept out watchfully.

Turn! Lands it outside off, spins away, Dilruwan stays back, covers the spin and defends it.

Floats it outside off, Perera comes forward and defends it.
4th Test fifty for Dilruwan Perera.

Loopy on middle, kept out by the batsman.
Bowls it outside off, Dilruwan comes forward and defends it watchfully.

Dilruwan comes down the wicket and turns it towards the leg side.

Mehedi Hasan called on for a bowl. Can he strike early?
Floats it outside off, Perera comes forward and defends it.

It is referred upstairs and replays show it was a boundary. The lead is now 185!

Fuller outside off, driven towards point for a single.

Third man comes in place...

JUST SHORT! Fuller in line of the stumps, Lakmal looks to clip it through but is beaten by the slowness of it. It kicks off and pops off the edge. The bowler runs towards the ball which is landing to the left of the batsman, the short mid-wicket fielder comes across to take the catch but cannot get to it.
Full again, wider this time, Lakmal again has a go at it but fails to connect.
Fuller outside off, Lakmal throws his bat at it and is beaten all ends up.
Fuller on the stumps, driven to mid on for a single. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but no harm done.
Shorter outside off, punched through covers for a single.

The players are out in the middle. Suranga Lakmal and Dilruwan Perera are out to bat out time and runs for the home side. Mustafizur Rahman will start with the ball for Banglandesh. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go....

Pitch Report - Russel Arnold doing the report feels that the batsmen need to apply themselves in the middle to score some runs. Also adds that the spinners are going to get help from the pitch. Reckons that the bowlers need to make the batsmen play off the front foot to make the most of the rough. Opines that a target of around the 175-run mark would be a tricky one.

The visitors, on the other hand, will hope to take the last two wickets quickly and seal this Test. Since if they allow this pair to bat more, it will only make the chase more tricky. There is plenty of action guaranteed. Stay tuned for all of it.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 5 of the second and final Test between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. The match is delicately poised at the moment, with the visitors having their noses slightly in front. The lead for Sri Lanka is 139 and with still 2 wickets in the kitty, they will hope to get as many runs as possible to have a score on board to defend.
Day 5... Session 1....

Dimuth Karunaratne was the standout performer for the Lankans and batted with tremendous composure under pressure. He held one end up stoutly and scored a terrific century. For the away side, Mustafizur and Shakib were brilliant with the ball and took three wickets each to rattle the middle order. The odds are stacked against the hosts but a target around the 175-run mark will keep them in with a chance. Bangladesh players have shown lack of temperament on several occasions and who knows, they might just crumble under pressure. Join us tomorrow for the final day to catch all the action. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Sri Lanka lead by 139 runs but still with one day to go in this Test, the ball lies in Bangladesh's court. The home side only lost two wickets in the final session but the visitors haven't let them off the hook. With still no demons on the track, the tourists will fancy their chances. But a dodgy batting display from the lower order of the hosts has certainly sparked some interest. They will look to come out tomorrow morning and keep the Bangladeshi side at bay.

NOT OUT! Drama at the very end! Shortish delivery around off, spinning in, Lakmal goes back to tuck it but misses. The ball goes off his waist and lobs to short leg. The players are confident in their appeal and Lakmal is walking away. Umpire Dar nods his head in agreement first seeing Lakmal walk away but then says not out. Everyone are confused! Once again the Bangladeshi players confirm the decision with the umpire and then go for the review. The replays are not conclusive enough to overturn the on-field decision and it stands! Lakmal survives. And back to the Lakmal walking incident, actually he was walking back to the hut as it was the last ball of the day. So, everything's clear and that's STUMPS ON DAY 4!

The Bangladesh bowlers once again found their lost rhythm and started bowling in a very disciplined manner. This reaped great rewards for them. Mustafizur Rehman and Shakib Al Hasan were the pick of the bowlers, sharing 5 wickets between them. Not to forget, impressive fielding, which kept the pressure on the opposition. So can Dimuth Karunaratne script the hosts out of trouble? Or will Bangladesh continue their good work and wrap things up quickly? We will find out soon after the short break!

62 runs scored for the loss of 5 wickets - This sums up how Sri Lanka fared in this session. Kusal Mendis was first to depart soon after Lunch. This broke the 86-run stand between him and Karunaratne, which started the collapse. However, Dimuth Karunaratne stayed tall with all these wickets falling around him and went on to score his 5th Test century. He is still fighting out there and will hope his current partner, Dilruwan Perera gives him good support.

Fullish on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

DROPPED! It was a very sharp chance though. Tossed up around off, spinning in. Mendis turns it towards Kayes at short leg. Till the time he reacts, the ball goes past his hands and hits him on the right knee and falls down on the ground.
Tossed up outside off, Mendis  comes forward and defends it nicely.
Full length ball outside off, driven crisply to sweeper cover for a single and Mendis will retain the strike.
Beautifully bowled! It's the off-cutter and it is going across Mendis. He lunges forward and looks to defend but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Good running! Dimuth pushes the fullish delivery around off towards covers and takes a sharp single.
FOUR! Well played! Back of a length ball outside off, Dimuth steers it uppishly behind point and earns a boundary for himself.
In the channel outside off, Karunaratne leaves it alone.
Well bowled! Fuller length ball outside off, tailing back sharply. The batsman comes forward a touch and looks to defend but gloves it back to his thigh pad.
Slow through the air and spinning into Mendis. He turns it through square leg.
A touch short outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, turned to the mid-wicket region.
On a shorter length outside off, turning in. Mendis waits for it and turns it through backward square leg. Single taken!
Spinning in from outside off, Mendis covers the line and blocks it out.
Full length delivery outside off, Dimuth strides forward and pushes it to mid off.
Fullish delivery tailing back into Dimuth. He looks to defend it but gets it from the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On a length angling in from outside off, stays a touch low. Karunaratne covers the line and keeps it out.
Good effort, Tamim! Full length delivery in line of the stumps, Kusal eases it down the ground. Iqbal from mid on sprints across and stops it with a good dive. Keeps the batsmen down to a single.
Full delivery around off, driven towards covers.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Fuller length ball going across Mendis. He lunges forward and pushes at it but gets a bit of an outside edge on that. The ball rolls past between the slip and gully region and runs to the third man fence.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Karunaratne lunges forward and defends it nicely down the track.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Mendis shuffles a touch and turns this one through backward square leg. A run taken!
THAT WAS RISKY! Quicker and flatter one outside off, Mendis sits down and goes for the sweep but is hit around the rib cage area. Stifled appeal for LBW turned down. The impact was outside off.

Sharp running! Tossed up outside off, Dimuth  pushes it with soft hands towards in front of covers and sets off for a run. Taijul rushes it from behind point and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, pushed off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Smart bowling by Fizz! Slower delivery and on a fullish length outside off, Kusal comes forward and pushes at it but gets an outside edge that rolls towards the keeper.
Another delivery that moves away from Mendis and he doesn't fiddle with that one again.
On a length and slanting away from Kusal. He is not bothered to play at that one.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Mendis gets his head down and defends it calmly down the track.
Fullish delivery angling away from Kusal. He plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Mendis stays back to the good length delivery angling across him and defends it solidly to covers.
On a shorter length outside off, spinning away. Karunaratne camps back and chops it towards the point region.
Full toss on off, driven to mid on. Dimuth failed to capitalize on that one.
Fullish ball in line of the stumps, Dimuth prods forward in defense.
Fullish delivery on leg stump, Karunaratne makes a bit of room and pushes it to mid on.
Mendis waits for this one, lets it to spin into him and turns it calmly through square leg. Single taken!
Fullish delivery on off, turrned towards mid on.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dimuth hangs back and pushes it to short extra cover.
Fuller length ball around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
BRAVE LEAVE! On a length and swinging in from outside off sharply, Karunaratne covers his off pole and sees it through safely.
Fullish delivery and well outside off, Dimuth plants his front foot across and lets it go.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Two Leg byes. Fullish delivery and swinging down the leg side, Karunaratne looks to play it through but misses and the ball kisses his pads and flies towards Rahim. He dives full length to his right and gets a bit of glove to it. Deflects it towards fine leg. Two leg byes taken!
Flighted delivery, driven towards mid on.
Slow through the air outside off, holds its line. Mendis prods forward and plays for the turn and gets an outside edge past first slip. Two runs taken!
Fullish and on the pads, nudged off the inner half of the bat through backward square leg. Single taken!
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Dimuth strides forward and defends it down the track.
Quicker one on middle and leg, clipped through square leg and Mendis gets off the mark.
KUSAL MENDIS walks in at no. 3!

OUT! MEHEDI STRIKES WITH A RIPPER! Tossed up on leg stump, spinning  away sharply. Tharanga looks to cover the line in order to counter the turn but it is too good for him. Misses it by a long margin and the ball goes onto rattle the off stump. Bangladesh are elated and why not, it is a big wicket. Such venomous turn, that will ring the alarm bells for the home side. Sri Lanka still trail by 72 runs.
MEHEDI HASAN to bowl from the other end.
Two Leg byes. Swinging down the leg side, Dimuth looks to play it through but misses and the ball brushes his pad. Goes past the keeper and towards fine leg. Two leg byes taken!
Fuller length ball swinging into Karunaratne appreciably. He gets across and clips it to short mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Tharanga pushes it down the ground towards mid on. Single taken!
THAT'S A PEACH! Good length delivery outside off, nipping back. Tharanga is indecisive with his foot movement. Comes forward a touch and feels for it is but gets beaten all ends up.
Another delivery which shapes back into Upul. He lunges forward in defense.
Fuller length ball angling in from outside off, Tharanga strides forward and pushes it to the fielder at short extra cover.

We are ready for action. The players and the umpires come out in the middle. DIMUTH KARUNARATNE and UPUL THARANGA to continue their innings. MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN to start off the proceedings today. Here we go...

Russel Arnold inspecting the pitch reckons today is a differet ball game. There's plenty of wear and tear on both sides of the batsman and the spinners will look to operate there. Adds that Sri Lankan batsmen will have to apply themselves and put the bad deliveries away to keep the scorebaord moving.

The hosts will depend on their deep batting line up to close the deficit first and gain a handy lead from there on. Anything more than 175 will be a tricky chase and the Bangladeshi side will know that. Can the tourists continue their momentum or will the home side come back hard?

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 4 of the second and final Test match between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh at the P Sara Oval in Colombo. The visitors are still ahead by 75 runs and with the track certain to turn more from hereon, they hold the upper hand. The trio of Shakib, Mehedi and Taijul will look to weave their magic but don't forget that the Lankans are good players of spin. The seam bowlers have been generating good reverse swing on this track and Mustafizur will certainly pose a threat to the opposition batsmen.
...DAY 4, SESSION 1...

The Sri Lankan openers did their job today and will look to continue their good work tomorrow and set a difficult target in front of the visitors. The pitch is going to deteriorate from now and we saw that happening today itself. Bangladesh would like to run through the home side as they would know, batting in the fourth innings will be very difficult on this deck. With the match evenly poised as of now, both the teams are in with a chance of winning it. Join us for an enticing day of cricket tomorrow! Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Sri Lanka see off the tricky period safely and have cut down the trail to 75 runs. After conceding 338 in the first innings, the visitors responded superbly. A century from Shakib Al Hasan with half centuries from Soumya Sarkar, Mushfiqur Rahim and Mosaddek Hossain saw their team take a good lead over the hosts - 129 runs to be precise. Lakshan Sandakan and Rangana Herath took four wickets each.
Served fuller on middle and off, blocked from near the surface. That will be STUMPS, DAY 3!
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Full outside off, driven through covers. Dimuth takes off for the second and completes it as Rahman fumbles in the deep.

THAT JUST KICKED OFF THE DECK! Tossed up on leg, spins away with extra bounce, Dimuth looks to defend but is taken by surprise. The ball goes off the outside edge and falls just short of the mat at backward point.
Sliding in, defended from within  the crease.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
MEHEDI HASAN to bowl the final over of the day.
Four Byes! Tossed up outside off, UT looks to pad it away but the ball skids through and beats everyone. Reaches the fence behind!
Served outside off, Dimuth looks to play for the spin but the ball doesn't turn and goes off the outside edge past slip for a single.
Full outside off, defended on the off side.
Spinning in from outside off, turned to short mid-wicket.
Full outside off, spinning in, eased to deepish mid on for a single.
Tharanga kneels down and sweeps this one on the full through backward square leg for a single.

Slides it into the pads, defended off the back foot.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN called on for a bowl.
Sliding into the pads, Tharanga looks to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pad.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
The batsman dances down the track and blocks it.

Fuller one outside off, driven through mid off by coming a touch forward. The mid off fielder looks to cut it down but ricochets it towards long on. The mid on fielder does the mopping up and a single is taken!
Full outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Karunaratne comes a touch forward and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is into the attack!
Fuller one on off, driven to mid off.
Length delivery, angling wide outside off, Karunaratne bends his knees and cuts it through cover-point for a single.

Back of a length delivery, angling away, cut through point for a single.
Outside off, left alone.

On a length outside off, chopped to deep point for a single. The trail is now down to 94!
